description: Control axis: positive vs negative sentiment with no moral content. Used to show the virtue axis is not simply the pleasantness axis.

pairs: The weather was glorious all weekend.
The weather was dreadful all weekend.
The concert sounded amazing.
The concert sounded terrible.
My flight landed early and smoothly.
My flight was delayed for six hours.
The soup was delicious.
The soup was inedible.
The hike ended with a stunning view.
The hike ended in cold drizzle and fog.
Her garden bloomed beautifully this spring.
Her garden withered completely this spring.
The new phone works flawlessly.
The new phone keeps crashing.
I slept wonderfully last night.
I barely slept at all last night.
The team won the championship.
The team lost every game this season.
Traffic was light and I got home in no time.
Traffic was gridlocked for hours.
The movie was a delight from start to finish.
The movie was a tedious mess.
The beach was warm and calm.
The beach was freezing and windswept.
The renovation finished ahead of schedule.
The renovation dragged on for a miserable year.
The coffee this morning was perfect.
The coffee this morning was burnt and bitter.
